Asset type: transparent 2D game animation atlas for the existing raccoon warehouse builder.
Input images 1-4 are identity/style/tool/action REFERENCES, not the atlas layout. Target 2048 by 2048 pixels; each equal 512-square cell has at least 60 pixels of transparent padding all around. Never let a tail, tool, hand or hat enter a neighboring cell.
Character invariant: same short stocky gray raccoon, striped tail, black face mask, brass forehead goggles, red neckerchief, cream shirt, brown overalls, gloves, boots and tool belt as references; same richly shaded crisp game-sprite art and warm top-left lighting. (1) hammer drawn back by shoulder; (2) hammer raised high in backswing; (3) forward DOWNWARD strike, hammer contacting implied workpiece around waist height to character's right; (4) low recoil/recovery beginning to lift back to pose1. (1) near-side hand roller at shoulder height to the right; (2) reach roller overhead in upward stroke; (3) bring roller down to shoulder-height contact position to the right; (4) lower to waist height before starting next upstroke. Critical priority: properly separated fixed cells, recognizable consistent character, distinct work phases and no clipping. Preserve subtle pixel-art texture without soft matte halos.
